basics.full_summary: Hello, my name is Mahmoud Ezzat. I'm from Cairo. I'm studying computer science at Modern Academy and hold a baccalaureate degree. Additionally, I'm studying a data engineering master class from Apprentice and working as a computer counselor at the National Telecommunication Institute. I also study under the guidance of professional instructors and benefit from many courses that help develop my skills in the field of computer science. I believe in the importance of continuous learning and interacting with experts to achieve success in this field. Furthermore, I have started learning through YouTube with some applications that help in development and building. I have also studied how to design business models and projects through Sprintix and ALX, learning to plan and design professional business models. I have also been utilizing social zakat tools, which have helped me learn and improve my technological abilities. These tools have provided access to educational resources and tech communities, helping me enhance my technology skills and interact with experts in my field.
